metadata.name: Robust Task
metadata.description: Filesystem-only reliable execution for complex tasks with durable plans and evidence, independent reviews, bounded retry and escalation, replanning, and truthful delivery.

nodes.directive: Establish the durable workspace for this Robust Task. Read the user's complete request and applicable local instructions. Resolve only ambiguity that materially changes the result; otherwise proceed autonomously. Create or resume exactly one ./moira-ws/<task-name>-<YYYYMMDD>-<HHMM>/ workspace, correlated by process-id.txt containing {{executionId}}. Write the authoritative task-requirements.md directly from the confirmed request and write a concise workflow-guide.md covering filesystem authority, recovery, plan quality, evidence, independent review, and the rule that mechanical checks prove only what they measure. Do not first return or relay either file body through workflow context. Read the files back and verify that they completely and accurately represent the task and guidance. Return only the trailing-slash workspace_path.
nodes.completionCondition: One recoverable workspace contains the exact process ID, complete frozen requirements, and sufficient workflow guidance; workspace_path resolves to it.

nodes.directive: Read {{workspace_path}}task-requirements.md, {{workspace_path}}workflow-guide.md, the real project context, and every source needed to understand the task. Build a coherent goal-first plan with as many substantive steps as the task actually requires. Give an intelligent executor the purpose, relevant context, expected outcome, and fitting acceptance gate for each step without scripting intellectual work mechanically. Create the next unused plans/NNN/ directory, write its plan.md, and preserve all earlier plan versions. Return only its workspace-relative current_plan_file and exact total_steps.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete executable plan derived from the frozen requirements exists in a new immutable plan-version directory, and its returned path and length are exact.

nodes.directive: Delegate an independent peer review of {{workspace_path}}{{current_plan_file}} against the complete frozen requirements, real project context, and workflow-guide.md. Judge whether the plan reaches the goal, covers every obligation, uses coherent granularity, preserves executor judgment, supplies enough isolated context, and defines fitting verification. Report only reproducible blocking defects; zero is valid. Write the complete current finding set to review.md beside the reviewed plan, replacing only that plan version's current review report. Return only the exact issues_count.
nodes.completionCondition: An independent complete review of the exact current plan is stored beside it and issues_count equals the report's blocking findings.

issues_count.description: Exact blocking finding count in the current plan review

nodes.directive: Plan review reached the configured bound after changed plan versions. Show the user the current plan and its review.md by reading them from {{workspace_path}}{{current_plan_file}}. Ask whether to continue repairing confirmed findings or explicitly accept the current reviewed plan for the separate approval gate. Record the exact decision and reason in review-limit-decision.md beside the plan. Return only the decision.
nodes.completionCondition: The user explicitly chose repair or accept and the exact decision is durable beside the current plan.

decision.description: User decision at the bounded plan-review gate

nodes.directive: Read the complete review.md beside {{workspace_path}}{{current_plan_file}}, reproduce every blocking defect against the current plan and requirements, and fix each confirmed defect across its whole class. Create the next unused plans/NNN/plan.md as the new complete plan; preserve the reviewed version and report. If a finding cannot be reproduced or the plan cannot be changed meaningfully, stop at this directive and explain the concrete blocker to the user instead of submitting an unchanged loop. Return only the new current_plan_file and exact total_steps.
nodes.completionCondition: Every reproducible finding is fixed in a distinct new complete plan version, and the returned path and length describe that changed plan.

nodes.directive: Show the user the complete reviewed plan at {{workspace_path}}{{current_plan_file}} and the review and review-limit decision beside it when present. Ask for explicit approval or rejection. Record the exact response in decision.md beside this plan. Return decision=yes only for unqualified approval; any feedback or requested change is decision=no and remains in the durable decision file rather than workflow context.
nodes.completionCondition: The user explicitly approved or rejected the exact current plan and the complete response is durable beside it.

decision.description: Explicit approval of the exact current plan

nodes.directive: Read decision.md beside {{workspace_path}}{{current_plan_file}} and apply the user's exact feedback. If and only if that response explicitly changes the task contract, update task-requirements.md and record the authorization and reason in the new plan directory. Preserve completed steps 1 through {{current_step}} - 1 when execution has begun. Create a distinct new complete plan version and return only current_plan_file and exact total_steps.
nodes.completionCondition: The exact user feedback is reflected in a new complete plan, any requirements change is explicitly authorized and durable, and completed work remains preserved.

nodes.directive: Execute only step {{current_step}} of {{total_steps}} from {{workspace_path}}{{current_plan_file}} against the real artifact and frozen requirements. Retry budget position {{step_retry}} controls escalation; it is not the durable attempt number. Read all prior evidence, verdicts, and the latest exhausted-retry decision for this step when present. Use its changed input or hypothesis; when the user already supplied concrete work or evidence, inspect and persist that result rather than repeating the mutation blindly. Derive the three-digit plan version from current_plan_file, choose the next unused numeric attempt directory under steps/{{current_step}}/plans/<plan-version>/attempts/, preserve every earlier attempt, and write concise sufficient evidence there as evidence.md. Return only that workspace-relative evidence_file.
nodes.completionCondition: The current plan step is executed as far as its gate requires; a changed input or hypothesis justifies the attempt; and a new plan-qualified evidence file exists without overwriting any earlier attempt.

nodes.directive: Delegate an independent peer review of the exact attempt evidence at {{workspace_path}}{{evidence_file}}. Read the frozen requirements, current plan, real artifact, and relevant earlier outcomes. Judge the step's own gate and plan integrity by the fitting method; mechanical checks prove only the properties they measure. Write the complete verdict beside the evidence as verdict.md. Return its exact path, whether the step is accepted, and whether confirmed defects require changing the plan rather than retrying the same step.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete independent verdict exists for the exact plan-qualified attempt and its two routing judgments accurately represent the findings.

accepted.description: Whether the exact attempt fully passes the step gate

plan_must_change.description: Whether retry cannot resolve the confirmed defect without replanning

nodes.message: Robust Task step {{current_step}} exhausted {{max_retries}} attempts and needs a decision.

nodes.directive: Read the current step, every plan- and attempt-qualified evidence/verdict pair, and the frozen requirements. Ask the user to choose exactly retry, replan, or finish_incomplete and provide the exact information that outcome needs. Retry requires changed input, a new hypothesis, changed external state, or concrete work/evidence already supplied by the user. Replan requires instructions for the unfinished work and may change requirements only when the user explicitly names and authorizes the exact change and reason. Finish_incomplete requires the exact unresolved scope and reason and means stop remaining execution and automatic repair. Write the complete response and current plan reference to the next unused steps/{{current_step}}/decisions/NNN.md. Return only the decision enum and exact decision_file consumed by the selected route.
nodes.completionCondition: One explicit retry, replan, or finish_incomplete decision is durably recorded at an immutable path with all changed input, authorization, or unresolved scope its route requires.

nodes.directive: Read the exact failed verdict at {{workspace_path}}{{review-step.verdict_file}}, the current plan, frozen requirements, and completed outcomes. Replan the open step and unfinished tail so the confirmed plan-changing defect is resolved; preserve steps before {{current_step}} unchanged. Create a distinct complete plan version and return only current_plan_file and exact total_steps. This route does not consume a normal retry.
nodes.completionCondition: A new complete plan resolves the verified plan defect, preserves completed work, and accurately reports its path and length.

nodes.directive: Read the exact replan decision at {{workspace_path}}{{ask-retry-decision.decision_file}}, the current plan, frozen requirements, and completed outcomes. Preserve completed steps and reshape only the open step and unfinished tail. Keep requirements unchanged unless the same durable decision explicitly names and authorizes the exact requirement change and reason; when it does, update task-requirements.md and record that authorization in the new plan directory. Create a distinct complete plan version and return only current_plan_file and exact total_steps.
nodes.completionCondition: The durable replan decision is fully applied, completed work is preserved, requirements change only under exact explicit authorization, and a complete new plan is ready for review.

nodes.hint: Use during execution whenever new facts, missed scope, or the result of earlier work makes the unfinished plan inaccurate. Do not use it to reject a plan at the approval gate.
nodes.directive: Reassess the current plan against the real work and frozen requirements. Record the concrete replan reason in the next plan-version directory, preserve completed steps before {{current_step}}, and reshape only the open step and unfinished tail. Create the complete new plan and return only current_plan_file and exact total_steps.
nodes.completionCondition: A justified new complete plan preserves completed work and is ready for independent review and approval.

nodes.directive: Read the frozen active requirements, approved current plan, every durable step outcome and evidence/verdict pair, any explicit requirement changes, any existing final/criteria/acceptance.md, and the real deliverable. Verify every active success criterion and goal facet by the fitting method. Write the complete assessment to the next unused final/criteria/NNN-review.md. Keep accepted incomplete gaps visible in the report and exclude an unchanged gap already covered by explicit criteria acceptance from issues_count. Count every current unaccepted gap that requires repair. Return only review_file and exact issues_count; zero is valid.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete current criteria assessment grounded in real artifacts exists; accepted gaps remain visible; and issues_count exactly matches current unaccepted findings.

nodes.directive: Criteria review reached the configured bound after changed repair attempts. Show the user the complete current report at {{workspace_path}}{{verify-criteria.review_file}}. Ask whether to authorize another repair pass or explicitly accept the reported gaps as incomplete. Record the exact decision, scope, and reason in final/criteria/acceptance.md when accepting, or in a continuation record beside the review when authorizing repair. Return only the decision.
nodes.completionCondition: At the configured review bound, the user explicitly authorized another repair pass or accepted the exact reported gaps as incomplete, and the scoped decision is durable.

decision.description: User decision at the criteria-review bound

nodes.directive: Read the complete current criteria report at {{workspace_path}}{{verify-criteria.review_file}} and any existing criteria acceptance. Reproduce and repair only current unaccepted findings represented by issues_count; preserve every accepted incomplete scope. Write concise repair evidence to the next unused final/criteria/NNN-fix.md. If no meaningful authorized change can be made or a finding cannot be reproduced, stop here and explain the blocker rather than submitting an unchanged loop.
nodes.completionCondition: Every reproducible current unaccepted criteria finding is repaired, accepted gaps remain untouched, and a new durable record proves a meaningful artifact change.

nodes.directive: Delegate an independent final review. Read the frozen active requirements, approved plan, real deliverable, durable step attempts/verdicts/outcomes, latest criteria review, and any explicit criteria acceptance. Re-derive completeness rather than trusting executor summaries. Write the complete current finding set to the next unused final/reviews/NNN-review.md. Do not reclassify explicitly accepted criteria gaps as new findings, but identify any additional unresolved defect. Return only review_file and exact issues_count; zero is valid.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete independent review of the current real result exists and issues_count exactly matches its unresolved findings beyond explicit acceptance.

issues_count.description: Exact unresolved independent final-review finding count

nodes.directive: Independent final review reached the configured bound after changed repairs. Show the complete report at {{workspace_path}}{{final-review.review_file}}. Ask whether to continue repair or explicitly accept the unresolved findings as incomplete. Record the exact decision and reason in final/reviews/acceptance.md when accepting, or beside the current review when continuing. Return only the decision.
nodes.completionCondition: The user explicitly chose repair or accept_incomplete and the exact decision is durable.

decision.description: User decision at the final-review bound

nodes.directive: Read the complete independent report at {{workspace_path}}{{final-review.review_file}}. Reproduce and repair every confirmed unresolved finding across its whole defect class in the real deliverable. Write concise evidence to the next unused final/reviews/NNN-fix.md. If no meaningful change can be made or a finding cannot be reproduced, stop here and explain the blocker instead of submitting an unchanged loop.
nodes.completionCondition: Every reproducible final-review finding is repaired and a new durable record proves a meaningful artifact change.

nodes.directive: Derive the truthful final result from task-requirements.md, the approved current plan, durable decisions and step outcomes, latest criteria and independent final reviews when present, explicit requirement changes, and incomplete-acceptance records. If the latest decision for the still-open current step is finish_incomplete, read that exact durable decision, stop without further execution or repair, force delivery_status=incomplete, and disclose the open step, remaining active obligations, and user reason. Otherwise use delivery_status=complete only when no active obligation remains unresolved; use incomplete for explicitly accepted gaps or unresolved findings. Write the complete bounded result to final/delivery.md and disclose every incomplete scope in both the file and concise summary. Return only delivery_file, delivery_status, and summary.
nodes.completionCondition: The durable delivery accurately reflects the latest applicable state; finish_incomplete always produces disclosed incomplete delivery without further work; every returned value resolves; and complete versus incomplete is truthful.

workspace_path.description: Trailing-slash path to the execution workspace

current_plan_file.description: Workspace-relative path to the current complete plan

total_steps.description: Exact number of steps in the current plan

current_step.description: One-based current plan step; total_steps plus one after completion

step_retry.description: Zero-based retry index for the current open step

max_retries.description: Number of failed step attempts before user escalation

plan_review_round.description: Current automatic plan-review round within the bounded escalation policy

criteria_review_round.description: Current automatic criteria-review round within the bounded escalation policy

final_review_round.description: Current automatic final-review round within the bounded escalation policy

max_review_rounds.description: Maximum changed-artifact review rounds before an explicit user decision

delivery_file.description: Workspace-relative path to the durable final delivery record

delivery_status.description: Whether active obligations remain unresolved in the delivered result

evidence_file.description: Workspace-relative evidence path for the current exact attempt
